gostman.label: Gostman
gostman.description: Full backup: requests, folders, every environment, the global variables and the collection variables, without secret values

postman.label: Postman
postman.description: Collection v2.1, which Insomnia also imports. Scripts and checks are adapted to run in both, and the variables in use, except secret ones, become collection variables

openapiJson.label: OpenAPI JSON
openapiJson.description: OpenAPI 3.0 description of the HTTP requests

openapiYaml.label: OpenAPI YAML
openapiYaml.description: OpenAPI 3.0 description of the HTTP requests

html.label: HTML docs
html.description: One self-contained page to publish or print. Credentials are left out and variables stay as {{example}}

bruno.label: Bruno
bruno.description: A folder of .bru files with environments, saved as a .zip. Scripts and checks are adapted to run in Bruno

curl.label: curl script
curl.description: One curl command per request. Credentials become environment variable placeholders

har.label: HAR
har.description: HTTP Archive 1.2 with the requests and no responses

http.label: .http files
http.description: Requests for VS Code REST Client and JetBrains HTTP Client, one file per folder, with http-client.env.json environments

importResult.joinedEnvironment: An environment named "{{name}}" already existed, so the imported variables were added to it. Variables it already had kept their values.
importResult.scopedEnvironments_one: Environments from {{names}} apply only to its requests. To use an environment everywhere, set Available in to Every collection under Environments.
importResult.scopedEnvironments_other: Environments from {{names}} apply only to their requests. To use an environment everywhere, set Available in to Every collection under Environments.
importResult.scopedVariables_one: Collection variables from {{names}} apply only to its requests; an environment variable with the same name still wins.
importResult.scopedVariables_other: Collection variables from {{names}} apply only to their requests; an environment variable with the same name still wins.
importResult.settingsAttached_one: The settings for all collections in this import were added to the collection settings of {{names}}, so they apply only to its requests. Your own settings for all collections were not changed.
importResult.settingsAttached_other: The settings for all collections in this import were added to the collection settings of {{names}}, so they apply only to their requests. Your own settings for all collections were not changed.
importResult.settingsWrapped: The settings for all collections in this import were put on a new collection, "{{name}}", which holds everything imported, so they apply only to those requests. Your own settings for all collections were not changed.
